title: Which video for which product?
intro: Give each product its type. Pilotix shows you the video formats that work best for it.

typeHelp.2: Competitors sell a similar product, not the same.
typeHelp.3: Competitors sell exactly the same one.

why.1: Your product is new: people must understand it. Show it, explain it.
why.2: People compare: prove yours is better.
why.3: The product is the same everywhere: make them choose your shop (trust, offer, speed).

noProducts: Add products in Products & stock first.
chooseFirst: Choose the product's type: the recommended formats show here.
noRecs: No active format for this type. The control room can add some.
sendHelp: Espace créateur opens with this product, this stage and these formats.

stageHelp.top: People who don't know you yet.
stageHelp.middle: They watched or clicked, without buying.

circle.name: Life ad circle
circle.why1: Each product gets a small budget before it gets a big one.
circle.why2: The rules are written down: the whole team decides the same way.
circle.why3: A product that loses stops fast. A product that wins gets more.
circle.tap: Tap a round: its settings open next to it.
circle.ringLabel: The five steps of the circle
circle.note: Pilotix keeps your settings here. It does not launch or judge any ad by itself yet.

help.test: Each new product gets a small budget to see if people like it. Audience: all of Algeria, no interests, no age limit.
help.judge: We count the confirmed orders of each product in test. A product’s limit = its profit per delivered parcel × the share of parcels delivered.
help.scale: Winners enter the SCALE campaign, grouped by limit. A group’s bid cap = its lowest limit × the confirmation rate.
help.watch: We look at each SCALE group: the budget grows when the cost stays under the limit, and steps back when it goes over.
help.again: We film new videos, add new products, and the round starts again.

f.judgeCut: A product is cut up to
f.judgeCutCost: Also cut if the cost is over
f.watchBadDays: Bad days before stepping back or cutting
f.againMessages: Lost product with some orders: message ad
f.againAlways: Awareness and catalogue ads always on

h.testPerWeek: How many new products enter the test each week.
h.testVideos: Really different videos, not the same one twice.
h.testBuys: Test budget = this number × the bid cap, over the whole test.
h.testDays: The budget is for this whole length, not per day.
h.testBidCap: Off: Meta spends freely during the test.
h.judgeWin: Confirmed orders, with a cost under the product’s limit.
h.judgeCut: Confirmed orders: at this number or fewer, it is cut.
h.judgeCutCost: In times the product’s limit. 1.5 = one and a half times.
h.scaleBudget: Per day, in the ad account’s currency.
h.scaleKeepAds: The best ads of the test, with their post.
h.scaleDay: All the week’s winners enter on the same day.
h.watchChecks: How many times a week we look at SCALE.
h.watchGrow: When almost all the budget is spent and the cost is under the limit.
h.watchBack: When the cost stays over the limit.
h.watchGoodDays: Then we wait as many days before growing again.
h.watchBadDays: An ad that spent and stays too expensive is cut.
h.watchBrakeDays: The whole account too expensive this many days in a row: no new tests.
h.againVideoDay: The day all the videos of the next test must be finished.
h.againWeeks: How often a winner gets new videos.
h.againMessages: At a lower price, with the AI answering.
h.againAlways: They run during the whole circle.
